en: The postcard is a vintage photograph showing a historic, Gothic-style building complex with pointed arches, large windows, and towers. The setting appears to be a quiet, cobbled yard surrounded by old brick structures. The main focus is on the entrance and chapel of a hospital, characterized by its stone architecture and distinct European medieval influences. The image is black-and-white or sepia toned, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
